en_rules_text: Your first Meat dish each turn gets +1 Taste. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

Name: Seafood Counter
rules_text: During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez un plat Fruits de mer gagnez +1 Faveur et vous pouvez Eplucher 1.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.

Name: Cheese Wheel
rules_text: Your Cheese dishes get +1 Taste.
fr_rules_text: Vos plats Fromage gagnent +1 Gout.
en_rules_text: Your Cheese dishes get +1 Taste.

Name: Fry Station
rules_text: During judging if you present a Fried dish gain +2 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez un plat Friture gagnez +2 Faveur.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present a Fried dish gain +2 Favor.

Name: Red Sauce Empire
rules_text: Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.
fr_rules_text: Vos plats Tomate gagnent +1 Gout et coutent 1 de moins a apprendre.
en_rules_text: Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.

Name: Rice Cooker
rules_text: Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn. The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck even if it is not your first learned card.
fr_rules_text: Les plats Riz coutent 1 de moins a apprendre. Le premier plat Riz que vous apprenez chaque tour va au-dessus de votre deck meme si ce n'est pas votre premiere carte apprise.
en_rules_text: Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn. The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck even if it is not your first learned card.

Name: Burger Diplomacy
rules_text: When you learn this, each opponent gains a Burger from the market deck or supply. Your Burgers get +2 Taste. Opponents' Burgers count as Statuses for your effects.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous apprenez cette carte, chaque adversaire gagne un Burger depuis le deck de marche ou la reserve. Vos Burgers gagnent +2 Gout. Les Burgers adverses comptent comme des Statuts pour vos effets.
en_rules_text: When you learn this, each opponent gains a Burger from the market deck or supply. Your Burgers get +2 Taste. Opponents' Burgers count as Statuses for your effects.

Name: Bureaucratic Cheese Inspection
rules_text: Whenever an opponent presents a dish with 5 or more Taste, they gain a Yelp Review. Your tagless dishes cost 1 more Time to learn.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois qu'un adversaire presente un plat avec au moins 5 Gout, il gagne Avis Yelp. Vos plats sans tag coutent 1 Temps de plus a apprendre.
en_rules_text: Whenever an opponent presents a dish with 5 or more Taste, they gain a Yelp Review. Your tagless dishes cost 1 more Time to learn.

Name: Conveyor Belt Shogunate
rules_text: At the start of your turn each player Peels the top card of their deck. If you Peel a Dish this way, you may present it this turn.
fr_rules_text: Au debut de votre tour chaque joueur Epluche la carte du dessus de son deck. Si vous Epluchez un Plat ainsi, vous pouvez le presenter ce tour-ci.
en_rules_text: At the start of your turn each player Peels the top card of their deck. If you Peel a Dish this way, you may present it this turn.

Name: Nonna's Witness Protection
rules_text: The first time each turn an opponent gives you a Status, give that opponent Shame. Whenever an opponent gains Shame, gain 1 Favor.
fr_rules_text: La premiere fois chaque tour qu'un adversaire vous donne un Statut, donnez Honte a cet adversaire. Chaque fois qu'un adversaire gagne Honte, gagnez 1 Faveur.
en_rules_text: The first time each turn an opponent gives you a Status, give that opponent Shame. Whenever an opponent gains Shame, gain 1 Favor.

Name: Influencer Kitchen
rules_text: Whenever you give a Status to an opponent, gain 1 Favor. At the start of your Fridge step, if you gave no Status this turn, gain a Distraction.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois que vous donnez un Statut a un adversaire, gagnez 1 Faveur. Au debut de votre etape Frigo, si vous n'avez donne aucun Statut ce tour-ci, gagnez une Distraction.
en_rules_text: Whenever you give a Status to an opponent, gain 1 Favor. At the start of your Fridge step, if you gave no Status this turn, gain a Distraction.

Name: Review Bomb Campaign
rules_text: Whenever you add a Status to an opponent's deck, put 1 token here. If there are 7 or more tokens here at judging, you win the game.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois que vous ajoutez un Statut au deck d'un adversaire, mettez 1 jeton ici. S'il y a au moins 7 jetons ici au jugement, vous gagnez la partie.
en_rules_text: Whenever you add a Status to an opponent's deck, put 1 token here. If there are 7 or more tokens here at judging, you win the game.

Name: Meal Prep Subscription
rules_text: The first time each turn you draw 2 or more cards from one effect, gain 1 Time. At the start of your Fridge step, if you have no cards in hand, draw 1.
fr_rules_text: La premiere fois chaque tour que vous piochez au moins 2 cartes avec un effet, gagnez 1 Temps. Au debut de votre etape Frigo, si vous n'avez aucune carte en main, piochez 1.
en_rules_text: The first time each turn you draw 2 or more cards from one effect, gain 1 Time. At the start of your Fridge step, if you have no cards in hand, draw 1.

Name: Algorithmic Menu
rules_text: At the start of your turn look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may discard 1. If you discard a Status this way, gain 1 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Au debut de votre tour regardez les 2 premieres cartes de votre deck. Vous pouvez en defausser 1. Si vous defaussez un Statut ainsi, gagnez 1 Faveur.
en_rules_text: At the start of your turn look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may discard 1. If you discard a Status this way, gain 1 Favor.

Name: Meal Prep Containers
rules_text: At the start of your turn, if your Fridge is full, gain 1 Time. The first Dish you play from your Fridge each turn gets +1 Taste.
fr_rules_text: Au debut de votre tour, si votre Frigo est plein, gagnez 1 Temps. Le premier Plat que vous jouez depuis votre Frigo chaque tour gagne +1 Gout.
en_rules_text: At the start of your turn, if your Fridge is full, gain 1 Time. The first Dish you play from your Fridge each turn gets +1 Taste.

Name: FACTION - Appropriate
rules_text: Whenever an opponent presents only dishes from one faction, after scoring steal their lowest-Taste presented dish and add it to your discard pile.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois qu'un adversaire presente uniquement des plats d'une seule faction, apres le score volez son plat presente avec le plus faible Gout et ajoutez-le a votre defausse.
en_rules_text: Whenever an opponent presents only dishes from one faction, after scoring steal their lowest-Taste presented dish and add it to your discard pile.

Name: FACTION - Legislation
rules_text: During judging, if your highest-Taste dish has strictly more Taste than each opponent's highest-Taste dish, gain 2 Favor and each opponent loses 1 Favor.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement, si votre plat avec le plus de Gout a strictement plus de Gout que le meilleur plat de chaque adversaire, gagnez 2 Faveur et chaque adversaire perd 1 Faveur.
en_rules_text: During judging, if your highest-Taste dish has strictly more Taste than each opponent's highest-Taste dish, gain 2 Favor and each opponent loses 1 Favor.

Name: FACTION - Less Is More
rules_text: Whenever an opponent draws 3 or more cards from one effect, that opponent Scorches 1.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois qu'un adversaire pioche au moins 3 cartes avec un effet, cet adversaire Carbonise 1.
en_rules_text: Whenever an opponent draws 3 or more cards from one effect, that opponent Scorches 1.

Name: FACTION - Without Cream!
rules_text: At the start of your turn, if an opponent gained more Favor than you on their last turn, gain Favor equal to the difference, up to 3.
fr_rules_text: Au debut de votre tour, si un adversaire a gagne plus de Faveur que vous pendant son dernier tour, gagnez autant de Faveur que la difference, jusqu'a 3.
en_rules_text: At the start of your turn, if an opponent gained more Favor than you on their last turn, gain Favor equal to the difference, up to 3.

Name: Foreigner Mistrust
rules_text: At the start of your turn, each opponent gains a Judgment.
fr_rules_text: Au debut de votre tour, chaque adversaire gagne un Jugement.
en_rules_text: At the start of your turn, each opponent gains a Judgment.

Name: Wage Inequalities
rules_text: Whenever you present a dish with 5 or more Taste, each opponent gains Strike.
fr_rules_text: Chaque fois que vous presentez un plat avec au moins 5 Gout, chaque adversaire gagne Greve.
en_rules_text: Whenever you present a dish with 5 or more Taste, each opponent gains Strike.

Name: Distraction
rules_text: No effect. It is still annoying.
fr_rules_text: Aucun effet. C'est quand meme penible.
en_rules_text: No effect. It is still annoying.

Name: Food Coma
rules_text: While this is in your hand, your first card learned each turn costs 1 more Time.
fr_rules_text: Tant que cette carte est dans votre main, la premiere carte que vous apprenez chaque tour coute 1 Temps de plus.
en_rules_text: While this is in your hand, your first card learned each turn costs 1 more Time.

Name: Yelp Review
rules_text: During judging your highest-Taste dish gets -1 Taste. Then Peel Yelp Review.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement votre plat avec le plus de Gout gagne -1 Gout. Puis Epluchez Avis Yelp.
en_rules_text: During judging your highest-Taste dish gets -1 Taste. Then Peel Yelp Review.

Name: Health Inspection
rules_text: During judging if you present 3 or more dishes, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Health Inspection.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez au moins 3 plats, perdez 1 Faveur. Puis Epluchez Inspection sanitaire.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present 3 or more dishes, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Health Inspection.

Name: Strike
rules_text: The first Technique you play each turn costs 1 more Time. Then Peel Strike.
fr_rules_text: La premiere Technique que vous jouez chaque tour coute 1 Temps de plus. Puis Epluchez Greve.
en_rules_text: The first Technique you play each turn costs 1 more Time. Then Peel Strike.

Name: Shame
rules_text: During judging if you present dishes from 2 or more factions, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Shame.
fr_rules_text: Au jugement si vous presentez des plats de 2 factions ou plus, perdez 1 Faveur. Puis Epluchez Honte.
en_rules_text: During judging if you present dishes from 2 or more factions, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Shame.

Name: Judgment
rules_text: When drawn, reveal the top card of your deck. Peel it unless it is Japanese. Then Peel Judgment.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous piochez cette carte, revelez la carte du dessus de votre deck. Epluchez-la sauf si elle est Japonaise. Puis Epluchez Jugement.
en_rules_text: When drawn, reveal the top card of your deck. Peel it unless it is Japanese. Then Peel Judgment.

Name: Mangia Mangia!
rules_text: When drawn, discard all Dish cards from your hand. Then Peel Mangia Mangia!.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous piochez cette carte, defaussez tous les Plats de votre main. Puis Epluchez Mangia Mangia !.
en_rules_text: When drawn, discard all Dish cards from your hand. Then Peel Mangia Mangia!.

Name: On Strike
rules_text: When drawn, your Cook step ends. Then Peel On Strike.
fr_rules_text: Quand vous piochez cette carte, votre etape Cuisine se termine. Puis Epluchez En greve.
en_rules_text: When drawn, your Cook step ends. Then Peel On Strike.

Name: We Heard You Have Oil
rules_text: When drawn, discard the highest-cost card from your hand. Then Peel We Heard You Have Oil.
fr_nom: On a entendu que vous aviez du petrole
fr_Name: On a entendu que vous aviez du petrole
fr_rules_text: Quand vous piochez cette carte, defaussez la carte avec le cout le plus eleve de votre main. Puis Epluchez On a entendu que vous aviez du petrole.
en_rules_text: When drawn, discard the highest-cost card from your hand. Then Peel We Heard You Have Oil.
